item.title: WORLD RECORD – QUICKEST NISSAN R35 GTR – 6.40 AT 234mph
item.description: George Dodworth’s Nissan R35 GT-R “Night Fury,” built by T1 Race Developments, set a new quarter-mile world record at TX2K25, running 6.40 seconds at 234 mph, surpassing his previous records, showcasing a highly modified 3300WHP car with its original chassis.
